title: R6D default-recurrence runtime profile
question: Which implementation layers account for the default R6D BP-to-MWPM runtime in the frozen R6N cell?

scope.records: first 20 nonterminal frozen R6N trajectories in trajectory-index order
scope.recurrence: R6D local graph, damping 0.25, 40 iterations, tolerance 1e-8

acceptance: each profiled BP correction equals its frozen R6N correction
all timing layers are nonnegative and their record count is fixed
profile labels the Python-table implementation rather than extrapolating to GPU runtime
claim_boundary: This is an implementation profile, not a GPU benchmark, asymptotic complexity measurement, or a claim that BP intrinsically costs the measured ratio to compiled PyMatching.

identified_hotspots: per-message NumPy reductions and Python dictionary traffic
